## par-p08 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The conduct-septad remembered in the heart; the abode entered again; the discussion itself known — it names its own close.

*Rasa: śānta (tranquility) — The sthāyibhāva is knowledge (jñāna) in the mode of close (nigamana); the vyabhicāri is peace (śānti) of conduct remembered.*
